upsert.title: Agent Harness on Physical-Engineering's Last Exam (Kaggle)
upsert.summary: Online Kaggle competition hosted by Google: build an agent harness and write up the approach, then compete on the Physical Engineering's Last Exam benchmark (built with Mercor). Stage 1 is a Kaggle Writeup; top 100 advance to a hidden-task evaluation stage. Final deadline 5 Jan 2027.
upsert.eligibility: Registered Kaggle users aged 18+ (or local age of majority). Residents of Crimea, DNR/LNR regions, Cuba, Iran, North Korea and persons under US sanctions are excluded. Solo or teams of up to 5. Taken from an aggregator page; confirm on the Kaggle rules page.

prize.description: US$400,000 total prizes: 1st US$250,000, 2nd US$100,000, 3rd US$50,000 (team prize money split evenly unless agreed otherwise). Listed as prize money by an aggregator; the word 'cash' was not confirmed on the Kaggle page.

notes: Official Kaggle page could not be opened; details come from an aggregator (checked against organizer page 22 Nov 2026 per its own note). Cash nature of the prize and exact deadline time/timezone are unconfirmed.
